title.narrative: MindTogether (NOUSPR towards community-led solutions for mental health and wellbeing)

description.narrative: The project MindTogether aims to strengthen the National Organization of Users and Survivors of Psychiatry in Rwanda (NOUSPR) and improve conditions for people with psychosocial disabilities. It focuses on building sustainable organisational capacity through training of the board, staff and district leaders, supporting member registration, and enhancing governance. A key component is expanding the network of Patient Experts who provide community-based psychosocial support, crisis assistance and links to health services. The project also introduces craft‑based therapeutic activities in 10 districts to improve members’ well‑being and resilience. Advocacy efforts at district and national levels will address stigma, improve access to health services and insurance, and highlight gaps in policies—including protection against gender‑based violence. The project aims to increase NOUSPR’s visibility, strengthen community inclusion, and lay a solid foundation for long‑term organisational sustainability.
